The passage describes the Athenian constitution of the mid‑5th century BCE. In Classical Athens political rights were limited to **adult male citizens**. Citizenship was hereditary – a man had to be born to two Athenian citizen parents – and women, slaves, and resident foreigners (metics) were excluded from voting, holding office, or participating in the Assembly.

Thus the only group that could take part in the democratic process was:

**All adult men who were citizens of the state by birth.**

Final answer: (C)
